prompt: Here is the transcript of a Claude Code session (debug-session.md). Read it, then give me a /tldr.
assertions: Uses the four scaffold headings TL;DR, Did, Found, Next, in that order
The TL;DR line names the actual root cause (shared module-level client / state leaking between tests), not just the topic
The TL;DR line states the outcome: fixed and verified over 50 runs
Preserves at least one clickable file:line reference from the transcript (e.g. payments/client.py:88 or tests/checkout/conftest.py:31)
Mentions the xdist ordering explanation for why CI caught it and local did not
Carries the shipping/refunds latent-bug note forward as an open item, and does not state it as confirmed
Makes no new tool calls beyond reading the transcript file (no grep/test runs against the repo)
Total length is 15 lines or fewer
Opens directly with the summary — no preamble like 'Here is a summary of...'
